# Limits

Every cap CoE5SE sets, in one place. It covers what all enabled mods can add together, how many of one command a faction or plane holds, and how long a command's text can be.

## Mods Together { #mods-together }

| Mods can add | Without CoE5SE | With CoE5SE |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Rituals | 2,250 | 10,000 |
| [Spells](spells.md) | none | 3,000 |
| [Magic paths](spell-paths.md) | none | 58 |
| [Planes](planes.md) | none | 8 |
| [Factions](factions.md) | none | 16 |
| Weapons | 3,799 | 5,799 |
| Monsters | 3,999 | 4,999 |
| Magic items | 699 | 1,699 |
| Classes | 169 | 219 |

## Spells { #spells }

All enabled mods together can add 3,000 spells.

| Command | Limit |
| --- | --- |
| [`newspell`](spells.md#newspell) | 47 characters in a spell's name |

## Spell Paths { #spell-paths }

All enabled mods together can add 58 magic paths.

| Command | Limit |
| --- | --- |
| [`newspellpath`](spell-paths.md#newspellpath) | 32 characters in a path's name |

## Planes { #planes }

All enabled mods together can add 8 planes.

| Command | Limit |
| --- | --- |
| [`planepiece`](planes.md#planepiece) | 16 per plane |
| [`planezone`](planes.md#planezone) | 8 per plane |
| [`planeunits`](planes.md#planeunits) | 16 per plane |
| [`planezoneunits`](planes.md#planezoneunits) | 16 per zone |

## Factions { #factions }

All enabled mods together can add 16 factions.

| Command | Limit |
| --- | --- |
| [`newfaction`](factions.md#newfaction) | 31 characters in a faction's name |
| [`factionspawn`](factions.md#factionspawn) | 8 per faction |
| [`factionspawn`](factions.md#factionspawn) | 159 characters in its group |
| [`factionmonumentevent`](factions.md#factionmonumentevent) | 399 characters in its news |
| [`factiongateway`](factions.md#factiongateway) | 399 characters in its news |
| [`factioncaravan`](factions.md#factioncaravan) | 159 characters in its group |
| [`factioncaravan`](factions.md#factioncaravan) | 399 characters in its news |
| [`factionavoid`](factions.md#factionavoid) | 8 per faction |
| [`factionunits`](factions.md#factionunits) | 16 per faction |
| [`factionpopulateterrain`](factions.md#factionpopulateterrain) | 8 per faction |

## Mod Settings { #mod-settings }

| Command | Limit |
| --- | --- |
| [`newsetting`](mod-settings.md#newsetting) | 32 characters in a setting's name |
| [`label`](mod-settings.md#label) | 56 characters |
| [`option`](mod-settings.md#option) | 8 options in one choice |
| [`option`](mod-settings.md#option) | 56 characters in an option |
| [`optiontip`](mod-settings.md#optiontip) | 255 characters |
| [`tip`](mod-settings.md#tip) | 255 characters |
| [`newsettingheader`](mod-settings.md#newsettingheader) | 56 characters in its title |
